releases.description:
This is a Provider Selection Regime (PSR) contract modification notice, under the Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023. For the avoidance of doubt, the provisions of the Procurement Act Regulations 2015 do not apply to this award. This contract has now been formally modified.
Modification approved by ICB Executive Director of Finance on 24/04/2025
No conflict of interests were declared.

amendments.description:
This modification updates the contract value for associate commissioners to reflect new allocations received from NHS England. 
It is made in response to external factors beyond the control of the relevant authority and the provider: 
• changes in prices in accordance with a formula provided for in the contract documents (for example uplifts in prices published in the National Tariff or index linking) 
It does not render the contract or framework agreement materially different in character.
amendments.rationale:
Need for additional works, services or supplies by the original contractor/concessionaire: This modification is required to update the contract value for associate commissioners to reflect new allocations received from NHS England. This is permissible in line with Section 13 - 2A & 2B (ii) of The Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023.
It is made in response to external factors beyond the control of the relevant authority and the provider:
• changes in prices in accordance with a formula provided for in the contract documents (for example uplifts in prices published in the National Tariff or index linking) 
It does not render the contract or framework agreement materially different in character.
